info.title: ReadArena Mobile API
info.description: Interactive documentation for all ReadArena Android API endpoints. Protected endpoints use a Laravel Sanctum bearer token. Send X-Locale: en or sw (or Accept-Language) to choose the language for localized validation and response messages. Save the account choice with PATCH /api/language.

servers.description: Android emulator connecting to a local development server

tags.name: Reviews

get.summary: List improvement ideas submitted by the signed-in reader

200.description: The reader's ideas and pagination metadata

403.description: Only reader accounts can use this endpoint

post.summary: Submit an improvement idea, optionally with a file attachment
post.description: Send multipart/form-data. Attachments up to 10 MB are stored privately and can only be downloaded by the submitting reader or an administrator. Submission is limited to five requests per minute.

403.description: Only reader accounts can submit ideas

413.description: The PHP or web server request limit rejected the upload

422.description: Invalid title, description, category, attachment type, or attachment size

get.summary: Get one improvement idea submitted by the signed-in reader

200.description: Idea details and current review status

403.description: Only reader accounts can use this endpoint

404.description: Idea does not exist or belongs to another reader

get.summary: Download a private idea attachment
get.description: Only the reader who submitted the idea and administrators can download its attachment.

404.description: Attachment does not exist or is not accessible to this account

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search title, description, ISBN, author, or publisher

parameters.name: reading_status
parameters.description: Filter to books on the signed-in reader's shelf

get.summary: Get a published book, its quizzes, and aggregate reader performance
Get public quiz counts and aggregate reader performance for a published book
get.description: No bearer token is required. Returns only aggregate results for published quizzes; reader identities and individual scores are never exposed.

404.description: Book not found or not published

get.summary: Stream the published book PDF to an authenticated reader

200.description: PDF content streamed with private cache headers

post.summary: Sync reading progress for a book
Submit choice or text responses; written explanations may need manual review

200.description: Quiz auto-graded, or held for written-response review. Pending responses return a null score until finalized.
A reset email is sent when the account exists

post.summary: Reset a password using the emailed token

200.description: Password reset; existing API tokens are revoked

Mark an owned notification as read

200.description: Preference state for each supported notification type

put.summary: Register or refresh this Android device's Firebase push token
put.description: Call after Firebase issues a new registration token and when the signed-in account changes. Tokens are tied to the authenticated reader and never returned in API responses.

delete.summary: Unregister this device's Firebase push token
delete.description: Call when the reader signs out or disables push notifications. Only a token belonging to the signed-in reader can be removed.

404.description: Token is not registered to this account

get.summary: List upcoming scheduled shows

200.description: Scheduled shows with optional book details

get.description: Only upcoming scheduled shows are open. Eligible books are published books for which the reader has passed a published quiz.

200.description: Available book choices for the application form

422.description: Show is not open for applications
Show is not open for registration

delete.summary: Cancel the signed-in reader's show RSVP

get.summary: List applications submitted by the signed-in reader, including each selected book

post.summary: Apply to join an upcoming live show competition with a selected book
post.description: Choose one of the eligible books returned by GET /api/shows/{show}/application-options. The reader must have passed a published quiz for that book.

book_id.description: Published book ID selected from the application options endpoint.

422.description: Pass a published quiz for the selected book and apply before the show starts

get.summary: List duel invitations, verified books, and eligible opponents

200.description: Duel records and books for which the reader and listed opponents passed a published quiz

post.summary: Send another verified reader a duel invitation
post.description: Creates a pending invitation and sends an in-app notification. Both readers must have passed a published quiz for the selected book. Self-challenges and duplicate active invitations are rejected.

201.description: Pending invitation created and opponent notified

422.description: Both readers must have passed a quiz for this published book; self-challenges and duplicate active invitations are rejected

patch.summary: Accept or reject a pending invitation as the invited reader
patch.description: Sends an in-app notification to the challenger after accepting or rejecting.

403.description: Only the invited reader can respond

422.description: Only pending invitations can be answered

patch.summary: Cancel an invitation as its challenger

422.description: This duel can no longer be cancelled

get.summary: Get reader rankings for reading goals or quiz competitions

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Reading ranks every reader by distinct completed books, with book-goal progress as tie-breakers. Quizzes ranks readers by best passing quiz scores.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Reading leaderboard page; omitted for the quiz leaderboard.

200.description: Ranked reader list. Reading results include every reader account and are paginated; quiz results include readers with a passing score.

422.description: Invalid type, period, or pagination value

get.summary: Get a published quiz, aggregate reader performance, and questions without exposing correct answers

200.description: Quiz questions and choices, plus this reader's attempt count

404.description: Quiz or its book is unpublished or not found

username.description: Optional unique username for reader accounts.

translations.description: Map English UI source strings to localized display strings

profile_photo.description: JPEG, PNG, or WebP image; maximum size 2 MB

attachment.description: Optional PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, TXT, DOC, or DOCX file up to 10 MB.

points.description: Sum of this reader's best passing score for each published quiz in the selected period.

completed_books.description: Distinct books marked completed during the selected period.

books_goal_progress.description: Completed books counted across the reader's book goals.

books_goal_target.description: Total books targeted across the reader's book goals.

goal_completion_rate.description: All-time book-goal progress as a percentage; used as a tie-breaker.

BookSummary.description: Published book summary with aggregate metrics for its published quizzes. Reader identities and individual scores are not exposed.

quiz_readers_count.description: Distinct readers with at least one attempt on this book's published quizzes.

quiz_average_score.description: Average score percentage across graded attempts; pending written responses are excluded.

quiz_pass_rate.description: Percentage of graded attempts that passed; null when no graded attempts exist.

token.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token from the Android app.

allow_multiple_selection.description: True for multiple-choice questions; select every correct choice and no incorrect choices.

response_format.description: Tells Android which response control to display. Expected answers and marking guides are never returned.

answers.description: Choice options only. Text question answer keys are never sent to readers.

best_score.description: This reader's best score as a percentage from 0 to 100.

QuizPerformanceSchema.description: Public aggregate results; no individual reader scores or identities are disclosed.

average_score.description: Average graded score; pending written responses are excluded.

pass_rate.description: Percentage of graded attempts that passed; null when none are graded.

BookDetailResponse.description: Book details, published quizzes, and aggregate quiz performance. Reader identities and individual scores are not exposed.

PublicBookQuizPerformanceResponse.description: Aggregate performance data for one published book and each of its published quizzes. No reader identities or individual scores are included.

answers.description: Map each question ID to an answer ID, an array of selected answer IDs, or a text string. Use an array for multiple-choice questions. One-word and short answers are auto-marked against accepted variants; written_response answers are held for administrator review.

oneOf.description: Selected answer ID for single-choice and true/false questions.
Selected answer IDs; include every correct choice for multi-select questions.
Typed response for one-word, short-answer, or written-response questions.

score.description: Null until written responses are reviewed.

passed.description: Null until written responses are reviewed.
